definition: a tearing or being torn up by the roots.
example_en: The administration decided to root out corruption entirely.

definition: a man to whom a share, portion (as of a property or profit in a business) is due.
example_en: He is a shareholder in the property.

definition: the act of removing the faults and correcting; amendment; improvement.
example_en: Amendment is necessary to correct the mistakes in the writing.

definition: one who wears a cap.
example_en: That man wearing a cap came walking along the street.
